name: mdd-sim-gateway
tagline: Self-hosted SIM/eSIM gateway for VoWiFi, SMS, and cellular data
description: mdd-sim-gateway is a self-hosted gateway that puts SIM and eSIM capabilities on your own network: VoWiFi calling, SMS, cellular data, and isolated regional egress all run through a gateway you control. With 151 stars and 96 forks, it has already attracted an active self-hoster telecommunications community. For privacy-focused mobile setups, it turns carrier functions into infrastructure you own.
highlights: Self-hosted SIM/eSIM gateway for VoWiFi, SMS, and cellular data
Regional egress can be isolated per gateway
151 stars with 96 forks — an active self-hoster community
Carrier functions as infrastructure you own
curatorNote: The fork-to-star ratio is the tell here — 96 forks on 151 stars means people are actually running this. Telecom self-hosting is a deep rabbit hole, and this is one of its few proper gateways.
